findings.title: Node.js - Wednesday, October 21, 2026 Security Releases
findings.summary_md: The official Node.js advisory lists the October 21, 2026 security release fixing 10 vulnerabilities. It names CVE-2026-111497 as the Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write permitting remote code execution, and notes patched versions 22.23.4, 24.22.1, and 26.12.1. The page also covers TLS hostname bypass (CVE-2026-106069) and other high- and medium-severity issues.

findings.title: Node.js Security Update Fixes 10 Flaws, Brotli RCE
findings.summary_md: CyberUpdates365 reports the October 21, 2026 Node.js security update addressing 10 vulnerabilities across 22.x, 24.x, and 26.x branches. It highlights the Brotli decoder flaw allowing remote code execution and lists the fixed release lines, confirming the advisory release date.

findings.title: Node.js Patches Brotli RCE Flaw, 9 Other Vulnerabilities
findings.summary_md: Cyber Kendra details CVE-2026-111497 and the fixed versions 26.12.1, 24.22.1, and 22.23.4, released October 21, 2026. It notes the Brotli RCE and three TLS hostname bugs among the ten patched flaws.

findings.title: Node.js Brotli RCE CVE-2026-111497: what to update
findings.summary_md: Wardio guides update to Node.js 22.23.4, 24.22.1, or 26.12.1, confirming the October 21, 2026 release. It describes the out-of-bounds write in Brotli decompression as the attack mechanism and advises restarting every Node process after upgrade.
